newsitem.title: SWEDEN: SAS tightens links with Sweden's Skyways.
newsitem.headline: SAS tightens links with Sweden's Skyways.

text.p: Scandinavian Airline Systems (SAS) said on Tuesday it was strengthening its cooperation with Swedish regional airline Skyways.

"SAS passengers will have better connections to several new destinations in Sweden while Skyways passengers will be offered better tranfer possibilities to the SAS traffic system when timetables are coordinated," SAS said in a statement.
SAS said the increased cooperation, which would occur gradually, meant that all Skyways routes would have SAS route numbers or code sharing.
SAS staff would handle passenger services on flights where Skyways does not have its own personnel, SAS said.

Skyways flies to 19 airports in Sweden as well as Bjorneborg, Finland and Copenhagen. Its fleet has 11 Saab 340s and seven Fokker 50s. Last year the airline carried 560,000 passengers and had a turnover of 574 million crowns, SAS said.
